acceptance_rule: 360 C / 28 MPa and 380 C / 28 MPa are the mandatory primary pair.
360 C is below water Tc and compressed at 28 MPa; 380 C is above Tc and Pc.
374 C / 28 MPa is retained only as a diagnostic for near-critical nonlinearity.
Geometry, composition, PVI rate, controls, gravity and Corey/Pc sensitivity parameters are identical in the mechanism-isolation pair.
Use the same apparatus geometry and matched specimen/batch protocol; record thermal exposure/order to avoid history confounding.
Prepare/verify identical initial and injection compositions for the formal pair.
Use the same dimensionless PVI rate; document any Q difference caused only by measured PV_eff(T,p).
PR and CPA each pass BASE zH2O=0.20 at 360 and 380 C, 28 MPa; dedicated output is scw_temperature_control_0d.csv.
Density/viscosity models must be admissible at both 360 and 380 C.
First-class producer composition/recovery/selectivity infrastructure exists; formal 360/380 matched-PVI runtime evidence remains required.
Both members must pass the same component inventory/closure gate.
Measured T-dependent kr/Pc/k may appear only in a separately labelled full-physics analysis, not in the mechanism-isolation pair.
Design is fixed; laboratory inputs and paired 28 MPa runtime/property gates are still required.
